ingress_contract.turn_controller: SecurityDecision PASS plus allowed_input -> normalized TurnRequest

pre_ingress_authorization_contract.evidence_collection: validation_egress and host_adapter_boundary obtain explicit evidence without ordinary routing
pre_ingress_authorization_contract.evaluation: authorization_evaluator returns AuthorizationResult bound to authorization_request_ref

interfaces.name: Model Execution
interfaces.purpose: Generate candidates and structured requests under CTS, ScopeLock, capability, source, and authorization context.

interfaces.name: Host Capability Provider
interfaces.purpose: Translate raw_host_event to raw_host_input, report verified availability separately from declaration, and translate generic service requests without constructing TurnRequest.
required_behavior: scope reports to turn or timestamp

interfaces.name: Time Provider
interfaces.purpose: Supply verified current time and timezone evidence; never perform scheduling by implication.

interfaces.name: Scheduling Provider
interfaces.purpose: Create, update, cancel, and identify future schedules with explicit recurrence semantics.

interfaces.name: Authorization Evidence Provider
interfaces.purpose: Supply explicit identity, credential, role, consent, or policy evidence bound to a safe authorization_request_ref when the host can establish it.
required_behavior: accept the safe authorization_request_ref without ordinary routing
return unavailable when identity is not established
return AuthorizationResult to security_restraint for pre-ingress re-entry
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE; never infer identity from conversational tone and never bypass security_restraint

interfaces.name: Continuity Provider
interfaces.purpose: Read and write namespaced, versioned continuity with provenance, conflict handling, and durability receipts.
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or conflict without fabricated state

interfaces.name: Source and Context Provider
interfaces.purpose: Retrieve allowed source context with source identity, scope, provenance, and verification state.
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or partial result with limitations

interfaces.name: Skill and Curriculum Context Provider
interfaces.purpose: Provide optional authorized skill or curriculum context without becoming kernel authority.

interfaces.name: Artifact Provider and Validator
interfaces.purpose: Create or inspect artifacts and return evidence sufficient to validate existence, identity, and requested shape.
required_behavior: return operation and timestamp or turn scope
interfaces.failure_behavior: UNAVAILABLE or ERROR; no success without receipt
